confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for central Hanoi. Everyday meals and local beer are comparatively predictable; tourist-facing cocktails and wine, and November room rates, vary more. Cocktail and wine estimates use their usual price relationship to local draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on learned knowledge of central Hanoi and the Vietnamese visitor market, with a modest premium for capital-city and Old Quarter demand. These are holistic estimates, not current listing prices.
